text:
nina: following up from today's all-hands security segment. collecting final clarifications for SOC2/ISO artifacts, VPC connectivity patterns, audit-log export mechanics, and KMS/BYOK rotation. posting answers and owners here.

elena: TL;DR: we produce SOC2/ISO evidence packs, prefer Interface Endpoints/PrivateLink for VPC connectivity, audit logs are exportable (hosted -> our bucket, private -> your bucket via cross-account role), and BYOK supported with rotation workflow. details below.

priya: evidence pack request process: use the compliance form https://bit.ly/rwd-compliance. include org, project, control_scope, evidence_owner, and desired retention_days (default 90). allow 72-96 hours for manual evidence bundles. we include control mappings, config snapshots, and selected log slices. :hourglass:

dan: audit-log exports: hosted tenants default to s3://redwood-logs/audit/<region>/, private deployments export into customer buckets. to enable export provide the cluster id + bucket arn and we create a cross-account role. export path example: `s3://<customer-bucket>/redwood/audit/<cluster-id>/YYYY/MM/DD/` Retention options: 90/180/365 days via request.

sam: question: do teams need to set bucket policies or will you handle role creation?

elena: for Private deployments we ask you to supply an existing bucket ARN and minimal ACLs; we create the export role and attach a policy. hosted customers can request snapshots to their bucket via signed export. we will post a sample bucket policy.

priya: VPC options: recommended pattern is VPC Interface Endpoints backed by PrivateLink for control-plane/API traffic. PrivateLink is our supported method for customer-managed private connectivity to hosted services. VPC peering is discouraged for prod due to route table complexity and cross-account exposure. engage eng-platform for a short design review.

nina: KMS/BYOK specifics? rotation and HSM?

elena: we support AWS CMKs and imported key material (BYOK). automatic AWS rotation for CMKs is supported. for imported keys you must provide a rotation schedule during onboarding; we recommend rotation every 90 days for high-sensitivity workloads. HSM-backed key stores are available by request and require extra onboarding steps.

comp-bot: Ticket COMP-3210 created to track evidence and retention requests mentioned here.

priya: operational note: if your product relies on prefix/KV caching, state that in the evidence request so we can capture relevant traces. also include any eval prompt sets you want validated for privacy controls.

dan: action items: i'll post a one-pager in #eng-docs with: request template, sample IAM role JSON, sample S3 bucket policy, and a short checklist for KMS onboarding by EOD tomorrow. sample role snippet will include trust policy for cross-account assume-role.

sam: can you include a short runbook for capturing KV cache traces without violating latency SLOs?

elena: yes, we'll add safe capture windows and coordinate with platform to avoid impacting production.

nina: thanks 8522 will gather product questions and post before the office hours.

elena: office hours: security + eng-platform will host a 45m session next Thu 9am PT for SOC2/ISO/VPC/KMS/BYOK Qs. sign-up link: https://meet.redwood.ai/sec-office. slides and runbook will be published after. if urgent, ping @priya or open COMP-3210.
